info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Tax Adjustment API
info.description: The Customer Tax Adjustment API allows businesses to efficiently manage adjustments to customer tax information. This endpoint supports operations such as updating existing tax details for consumers, which is critical for ensuring compliance with tax regulations. Typical users of this endpoint include financial institutions and accounting systems that need to maintain accurate records of tax data. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their tax handling processes, enhancing operational efficiency and accuracy.

patch.summary: Update Tax Handling for Customer CUST-100045
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the tax handling information for the specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary tax details required for updating.

requestBody.description: Updates the tax handling information for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. This request allows for modification of the existing tax settings, ensuring that the customer’s tax-related preferences are aligned with current regulations or business requirements.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the resource has been updated.
